title: Make split-buffer audio switching transactional

definition.title: Make split-buffer audio switching transactional
definition.source_excerpt: Timeline · Follow-on architecture experiment · P1 · Risk: High First environment: Browser-only; adaptation integration later. Dependencies: None; verify prerequisites locally. Status: Untested hypothesis. Proposed mechanism. Keep one MediaSource/video element and a retained video SourceBuffer while replacing only the selected audio stream. Use prepare/validate/commit/retire around a defined switch time rather than treating successful appends as a seamless switch. Source basis. MSE supplies changeType, timestamp offsets and append windows. It permits, but does not guarantee, a particular multiple-SourceBuffer combination or continuous codec switch. [M1] First agent experiment. Exercise same-codec switching first, then AAC/FLAC/Opus transitions only where accepted. Test pause, seek-before-commit, encoder preroll and failed preparation. Compare video identity and digital audio markers around the boundary.
